entities.summary: Vitaliy Stanislavovych Koval is a Ukrainian entrepreneur and politician. Vice-president of the Ukrainian Wrestling Association. Member of the National Olympic Committee of Ukraine. Head of the Rivne Regional State Administration from September 9, 2019, to November 23, 2023, as Governor of Rivne Oblast.
